name: paper-figure-loom
description: Create or accept a paper-figure master, regenerate its fine-grained visual parts as transparent assets, and recompose them as an editable PowerPoint.

interface.shortDescription: Weave master figures into editable PowerPoint slides
interface.longDescription: Give Paper Figure Loom a paper or a complete master figure. It inventories and regenerates every fine-grained UI, icon, illustration, and decoration as a transparent asset, then recomposes them at the master's original positions as an editable PowerPoint with visual QA evidence.
defaultPrompt: Regenerate every fine-grained visual asset from this master figure with a transparent background, then recompose an editable PowerPoint at the original positions.
Create a complete method-figure master from this paper, regenerate its fine-grained UI and icon assets, and weave them into an editable checked PowerPoint.
